title: Farming Consistency
whatItIs: Whether you're converting lane time into gold at a rate that matches your rank.
theNumber: CS/min, checked against the Benchmarks table for your rank.
graduationBar: Land inside or above your rank's CS/min band for 3 straight games before moving on.

title: Death Cause Control
whatItIs: Whether your deaths cluster around one repeatable, fixable mistake.
theNumber: Most-repeated death cause across a 10-game block, from the Death Audit.
graduationBar: Your top death cause drops out of your top 2 causes for a full 10-game block.

title: Vision Cadence
whatItIs: Whether you place wards on a rhythm instead of only when you already feel unsafe.
theNumber: Longest gap, in seconds, with zero active wards in your area.
graduationBar: No gap over 90 seconds for 3 straight games.

title: Objective Timer Awareness
whatItIs: Whether you track and communicate objective spawns before they matter, not after.
theNumber: Objective timers called 30+ seconds early, out of total objectives that spawned.
graduationBar: Call at least 3 of 4 objective spawns early for 3 straight games.

title: Wave Management
whatItIs: Whether you can hold a lane advantage by controlling where the wave sits, not just by winning fights.
theNumber: Consecutive waves held at a freeze point without it collapsing.
graduationBar: Hold a freeze for 3 consecutive waves in Practice Tool, then once in a real game.

title: Trade Discipline
whatItIs: Whether you take favorable trades and then actually leave, instead of staying to "finish it."
theNumber: Trades that end in a clean disengage, out of 10 attempted.
graduationBar: 8 of 10 clean disengages in Practice Tool, then applied consistently in a real lane.

title: Jungle Clear Efficiency
whatItIs: Whether your opening clear is fast and consistent enough to support ganks on schedule (jungle role only).
theNumber: Your own calibrated clear-time baseline, in minutes:seconds.
graduationBar: Match or beat your own baseline for 3 consecutive Practice Tool runs.

title: Recall Efficiency
whatItIs: Whether you're recalling with a wave banked and gold used, not out of boredom or nerves.
theNumber: Low-value recalls per game (recalling with under 4 minions' worth of gold banked).
graduationBar: No more than 1 low-value recall per game for 3 straight games.

title: Minimap Awareness
whatItIs: Whether checking the minimap is an automatic rhythm rather than a conscious effort.
theNumber: Longest gap, in seconds, without a minimap glance during laning phase.
graduationBar: No gap over 15 seconds for a full laning phase, 3 games running.

title: Comms Discipline
whatItIs: Whether your in-game chat stays useful (plans, information) instead of becoming a tilt outlet.
theNumber: Complaint-only messages per game, ideally zero.
graduationBar: Zero complaint-only messages for 5 straight games, including at least one loss.

title: Post-Game Lesson Extraction
whatItIs: Whether every game actually teaches you something specific, instead of blurring into the next queue.
theNumber: One-sentence, specific-action lessons logged per game, out of games played.
graduationBar: A logged lesson for every game in a 10-game block, with no exact repeat lesson twice in a row.

title: Farming Under Pressure
whatItIs: Whether you keep your CS up even when the enemy is pushing you under tower or all-in range.
theNumber: Tower hits taken per 3-wave under-tower sequence.
graduationBar: Zero tower hits taken across 3 consecutive under-tower waves in Practice Tool.
